card.name: Inside researcher surnames in citations
card.fires_on: The later part of a researcher's surname, split across pieces, in news quotes, author lists or citations. It fires where the name ends or is nearly done, such as Lorsche<<ider>> or Burch<<ell>>.

modes.label: Quoted researcher in news
modes.description: Final piece of a scientist's surname just before 'says' or 'of' a university.
modes.example: "We are slowly moving closer and closer to implementation of genetic screening for CF," says Arthur Beaud<<et>> of the Baylor College of Medicine.

modes.label: Reference list authors
modes.description: Name pieces of authors in journal citations or in-text references.
modes.example: Roberts BW, Walton KE, Viechtb<<auer>> W in Psychol Bull. 2

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may favor word pieces like 'literal' or 'logical' and disfavor Chinese news words.
card.plain: It marks the end part of an unusual researcher's surname in a quote or citation.
